name: Do I need to empty my cabinets before painting?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to empty my cabinets before painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is necessary to empty your cabinets completely before painting. This allows our team full access to all surfaces for thorough cleaning, sanding, and painting, ensuring a professional and even finish. Removing contents also protects your items from paint dust or accidental splashes. We recommend storing your kitchen items in a nearby room or designated area. We will guide you on the best way to prepare your kitchen space before our work begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you must empty cabinets completely before painting. This ensures full access for preparation and painting, protecting your items from dust or splashes. We advise on preparation.
